count_unit: Sums of correlated query-ID/seed cases, not unique datasets or independent observations; do not add repeated baseline values across profiles.

definitions.aggregation: counts summed over correlated seed/query cases; no CI or independent-sample claim; baseline repeated across candidate profiles must not be pooled over profiles
definitions.keyword_false_baseline_hybrid_false_cand: observed new vector-only full-window admission, not exact HNSW oracle truth
definitions.keyword_false_baseline_hybrid_true: vector-only rank promotion of already observed admitted ID
definitions.keyword_true_top10: lexically eligible promotion, not a newly created keyword match; unexpected full membership changes separately counted
definitions.new_full_hybrid_admission: observed candidate full-hybrid ID set minus observed baseline full-hybrid ID set
definitions.new_known_grade0_top10: candidate known-grade0 top10 IDs minus baseline known-grade0 top10 IDs; not net count change
definitions.query_kind: literal frozen query kind; ambiguous never pooled into no_answer
definitions.utility_metrics: none computed; no recall, NDCG, MRR, primary latency, winner or default recommendation

label_policy.LEGACY: only explicit original numeric grade0 is false positive; 12 U remain unknown; no new judgments or clearing preexisting eight-case scientific concerns
label_policy.REAL: entirely unjudged; all FP/grade0/U metrics null, membership/admission counts only

membership_caveat: Observed actual-engine approximate full-window hybrid membership, not an exact HNSW oracle; KW IDs are actual Scala lexical matches. No root/nested causal branch attribution available.
original_U_policy: 12 original U pairs unchanged (9 positive-intent,3 ambiguous); never converted to grade0; newly appearing U top10 IDs=0 for all profiles. Eight preexisting scientific/primary concerns are not cleared.

real_population.interpretation: Only unjudged membership, full-admission and top10 ID-change counts; grade0/FP/U fields null, not zero; no false-positive claim.

source_metadata_scope: Literal frozen source query kind and split, as preserved by the all1680-row analysis; no query-id-prefix inference for population membership.
